intro.title: Build correlation ID middleware
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a correlation ID middleware for a Node.js Express application. You will learn how to generate a unique identifier for each incoming HTTP request and attach it to the request object for tracking purposes. The core programming concept involves middleware functions, which intercept and process requests in a pipeline. You will use key technologies like Express.js, the `uuid` library for ID generation, and HTTP headers. By the end, you'll have a functional middleware that logs correlation IDs to help debug and trace requests across services.
intro.usecase: Correlation IDs are essential in distributed systems like microservices architectures, where a single user request might trigger multiple services. In e-commerce platforms, when a customer places an order, correlation IDs help track the request through inventory checks, payment processing, and shipping services. This allows developers to trace errors across service boundaries in monitoring dashboards like Datadog or New Relic. Without correlation IDs, debugging production issues would be like finding a needle in a haystack across dozens of interconnected services.
